description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing media key capabilities, including creation, access, and querying supported key systems and versions within the Rialto client framework.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media keys capabilities querying and management, including supported key systems and versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the media keys capabilities object with an IPC factory.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Destructor that resets the IPC handle.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
